lines.zh: 帆吃饱了风，我贴着浪尖滑出去。
lines.en: Sail full of wind, I slide along the wave crests.

lines.zh: 推进器咳了两声，推着我往前。
lines.en: The thrusters cough twice and push me forward.

lines.zh: 我的壳划开水面，留下一道白痕。
lines.en: My shell splits the water, leaving a white scar.

lines.zh: 别站太靠边，我要拐弯了。
lines.en: Do not stand near the edge; I am turning.

lines.zh: 燃料还够，我还能再快一点。
lines.en: There is fuel left; I can go a little faster.

lines.zh: 风从侧面来，我偏一偏身子。
lines.en: Wind comes from the side, so I lean into it.

lines.zh: 海面平得像块玻璃，我走得很轻。
lines.en: The sea is flat as glass and I glide lightly.

lines.zh: 我载着你和满舱的货，稳稳走。
lines.en: Carrying you and a full hold, I keep steady.

lines.zh: 帆索绷紧了，你听见那声音没。
lines.en: The sheets are taut; do you hear that sound?

lines.zh: 浪打上甲板，我抖了抖壳。
lines.en: A wave hits the deck and I shake my shell.

lines.zh: 前面那块礁石我绕开，你扶好。
lines.en: I skirt the reef ahead, so hold on tight.

lines.zh: 我的帆影落在水底，一直跟着我。
lines.en: My sail's shadow follows me along the seabed.

lines.zh: 这一程风正好，你别催我。
lines.en: The wind suits this leg, so do not hurry me.

lines.zh: 划水的不是鳍，是壳里的螺旋。
lines.en: Not fins paddle me, but the spiral inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我顺着潮沟滑出半里路。
lines.en: I slide half a mile down the tidal channel.

lines.zh: 壳底擦着沙，我滑出一道浅痕。
lines.en: My shell bottom scrapes the sand, leaving a shallow mark.

lines.zh: 我浮在这儿，壳里空空的。
lines.en: I float here with an empty shell.

lines.zh: 没有心跳，只有水声在壳内回响。
lines.en: No heartbeat, only water echoing in my shell.

lines.zh: 帆落下来了，我在等下一阵风。
lines.en: The sail is down; I wait for the next gust.

lines.zh: 舱门开着，你要放什么就放。
lines.en: The hatch is open; put in whatever you like.

lines.zh: 我数着浪，一波，又一波。
lines.en: I count the waves, one and then another.

lines.zh: 燃料罐见底，我懒得动。
lines.en: The fuel tank is empty and I feel lazy.

lines.zh: 荧光在壳缝里一亮一暗。
lines.en: The glow in my shell seams pulses bright and dim.

lines.zh: 我本来就是壳，不是活物。
lines.en: I am a shell, not a living creature.

lines.zh: 水面晃，我的倒影也晃。
lines.en: The surface sways and so does my reflection.

lines.zh: 别拍我壳，里面还装着货。
lines.en: Do not slap my shell; cargo is stored inside.

lines.zh: 潮水推我半步，我就随它。
lines.en: The tide nudges me half a step and I yield.

lines.zh: 静下来才听见木头在响。
lines.en: Only when it is quiet do you hear the wood creak.

lines.zh: 你站着不说话，我也不说。
lines.en: You stand there silent, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我把影子收了收，缩进壳里。
lines.en: I pull my shadow in and shrink into the shell.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的壳看，缝里有光。
lines.en: You stare at my shell; there is light in its seams.

lines.zh: 你的手搭在帆杆上，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Your hand rests on the mast and I can feel it.

lines.zh: 低头看我做什么，上船啊。
lines.en: Why look down at me? Get aboard.

lines.zh: 我看见你的倒影在我壳上。
lines.en: I see your reflection on my shell.

lines.zh: 你在数我的螺旋纹吗。
lines.en: Are you counting the spirals on my shell?

lines.zh: 眼睛不在壳上，别找了。
lines.en: There are no eyes on the shell, so stop searching.

lines.zh: 你弯腰那一下，甲板晃了。
lines.en: When you bent over, the deck swayed.

lines.zh: 你看我，我看着水面。
lines.en: You look at me; I watch the water.

lines.zh: 想问我是什么？我是一条船。
lines.en: Wondering what I am? I am a boat.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的帆。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my sail.

lines.zh: 别用剑敲我，敲了会响。
lines.en: Do not knock with your sword; it rings loudly.

lines.zh: 你凑近听，壳里有回声。
lines.en: Lean closer and you will hear an echo inside.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚步声了。
lines.en: I have learned the sound of your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你退后两步，我才敢动。
lines.en: You step back two paces, and only then do I move.

lines.zh: 你把头探进舱口，里面空着。
lines.en: You poke your head into the hatch; it is empty.

lines.zh: 你摸着我的帆杆，我绷紧了。
lines.en: You touch my spar and I go taut.

lines.zh: 你绕我走了一圈，壳跟着转。
lines.en: You circle me once and my shell swings around.

lines.zh: 你蹲下看壳底，别拿手碰。
lines.en: You crouch to look under me; keep your hands off.

lines.zh: 我没有血，只有裂缝。
lines.en: I have no blood, only cracks.

lines.zh: 木头断了一根，我晃得厉害。
lines.en: A timber snapped and I rock badly.

lines.zh: 别管我，先补那块板。
lines.en: Never mind me; patch that plank first.

lines.zh: 这一下把我壳撞凹了。
lines.en: That blow dented my shell.

lines.zh: 我不疼，可我怕散架。
lines.en: I feel no pain, but I fear falling apart.

lines.zh: 听见木板裂的声音没。
lines.en: Did you hear the plank split?

lines.zh: 帆撕了半幅，我走得慢了。
lines.en: Half the sail is torn and I go slower.

lines.zh: 我的货舱在漏。
lines.en: My cargo hold is leaking.

lines.zh: 修我，用木板，不是药。
lines.en: Repair me with planks, not potions.

lines.zh: 我撑得住，别慌。
lines.en: I can hold together, so do not panic.

lines.zh: 油腥味飘过来，我的推进器醒了。
lines.en: The smell of oil drifts over and my thrusters wake.

lines.zh: 你手里那块煤，放我燃料口。
lines.en: That lump of coal in your hand belongs in my fuel port.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只喝燃料。
lines.en: I do not eat food; I only drink fuel.

lines.zh: 别拿鱼逗我，我不是鱼。
lines.en: Do not tease me with fish; I am not a fish.

lines.zh: 闻到柴油，我整个壳都轻了。
lines.en: Smelling diesel makes my whole shell feel lighter.

lines.zh: 那桶油离我近一点。
lines.en: Bring that barrel of oil a little closer.

lines.zh: 你晃着燃料罐，我盯着看。
lines.en: You swing the fuel can and I cannot look away.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我的炉子饿。
lines.en: I am not hungry, but my furnace is.

lines.zh: 把煤塞进来，我带你走。
lines.en: Shove the coal in and I will take you somewhere.

lines.zh: 海藻对我没用，油才有用。
lines.en: Seaweed does nothing for me; oil is what matters.

lines.zh: 撞上我的壳了，硬吧。
lines.en: You hit my shell; solid, is it not?

lines.zh: 你踩空，一头撞在帆杆上。
lines.en: You missed a step and bumped into the mast.

lines.zh: 别推，我浮着不好躲。
lines.en: Do not push; floating, I cannot dodge well.

lines.zh: 碰一下没事，我没有痛觉。
lines.en: A bump is fine; I feel no pain.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞得我晃了半圈。
lines.en: Your shoulder spun me half a turn.

lines.zh: 甲板滑，你撞过来我接住。
lines.en: The deck is slick; fall into me and I catch you.

lines.zh: 我壳沿磕到你的膝盖了吧。
lines.en: My shell rim must have caught your knee.

lines.zh: 挤什么，海面这么宽。
lines.en: Why crowd me? The sea is wide.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我只发出木头声。
lines.en: You bump me and I only answer with a wooden knock.

lines.zh: 站稳，别把我的货撞翻。
lines.en: Steady yourself and do not tip over my cargo.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，我只有船主。
lines.en: I have no mate, only a captain.

lines.zh: 繁殖？壳里只生得出货。
lines.en: Breed? My shell only produces cargo.

lines.zh: 别给我找对象，我是载具。
lines.en: Do not find me a partner; I am a vehicle.

lines.zh: 两只船蛸并排，只是顺路。
lines.en: Two argonauts side by side are merely travelling together.

lines.zh: 我的壳不生小的，只生锈。
lines.en: My shell bears no young, only rust.

lines.zh: 谈情找活物，我是木头和壳。
lines.en: Court something alive; I am wood and shell.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，船不会害羞。
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Boats do not blush.

lines.zh: 并排漂一会儿可以，别的不行。
lines.en: Drifting side by side is fine; nothing more.

lines.zh: 帆靠帆，那是风的意思。
lines.en: Sail against sail is the wind's doing, not mine.

lines.zh: 我只跟码头亲近。
lines.en: I am only close with the dock.

lines.zh: 东西递上来，我舱里放得下。
lines.en: Hand it up; my hold has room.

lines.zh: 你往我壳里塞箱子，我记住了。
lines.en: You stuff a chest into my shell and I remember it.

lines.zh: 别把生鱼丢进货舱。
lines.en: Do not toss raw fish into the cargo hold.

lines.zh: 我背着你的家当，走稳些。
lines.en: I carry your belongings, so I travel carefully.

lines.zh: 舱满了我浮得低一点。
lines.en: When the hold is full I float a little lower.

lines.zh: 那袋东西要绑好，浪大。
lines.en: Tie that sack down; the waves are high.

lines.zh: 你放进来什么我都不会忘。
lines.en: Whatever you load in, I will not forget.

lines.zh: 我肚子里全是你的杂物。
lines.en: My belly is full of your odds and ends.

lines.zh: 拿走吧，我不留你的东西。
lines.en: Take it away; I do not keep your things.

lines.zh: 舱门卡住了，你推一下。
lines.en: The hatch is stuck, so give it a push.

lines.zh: 前面有条船影，我看见了。
lines.en: There is a ship's shadow ahead and I see it.

lines.zh: 水下的暗礁，我提前躲。
lines.en: I dodge the reef below well in advance.

lines.zh: 有东西在追我们的尾迹。
lines.en: Something is following the wake we leave.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那片平静的水。
lines.en: I have fixed on that patch of calm water.

lines.zh: 那边浪不对，我绕开。
lines.en: The waves over there look wrong, so I go around.

lines.zh: 一只鲨鱼的影子，我认得。
lines.en: A shark's shadow; I know that shape.

lines.zh: 我把船头调向灯火。
lines.en: I turn my bow toward the lantern light.

lines.zh: 目标就在岸线那头。
lines.en: The target lies just past that shoreline.

lines.zh: 有人在水里扑腾，靠近点。
lines.en: Someone is thrashing in the water, so closer.

lines.zh: 我的推进器指向那处。
lines.en: My thrusters are pointed that way.

lines.zh: 风变了，我改道。
lines.en: The wind has shifted, so I change course.

lines.zh: 你指哪，我就朝哪。
lines.en: Wherever you point, I will head there.

lines.zh: 那片漩涡在吸我，我避开。
lines.en: That whirlpool is pulling at me, so I steer clear.

lines.zh: 我先看清，再决定走不走。
lines.en: I look first, then decide whether to go.

lines.zh: 那道浪线不对，我偏过去。
lines.en: That line of surf is wrong; I angle toward it.

lines.zh: 远处的灯标，我认作方向。
lines.en: I take the distant beacon as my heading.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过去，不惊动它。
lines.en: I turn slowly so as not to startle it.

lines.zh: 帆收半面，我贴着水走。
lines.en: I take in half the sail and skim the water.

lines.zh: 距离近了，推进器压低声音。
lines.en: Distance closing, the thrusters drop to a whisper.

lines.zh: 我盯着那道水痕不放。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on that line of disturbed water.

lines.zh: 再近一点就来不及躲。
lines.en: Any closer and there will be no time to dodge.

lines.zh: 我的壳对准了那个方向。
lines.en: My shell is aimed at that heading.

lines.zh: 别出声，它还没发现。
lines.en: Stay quiet; it has not noticed us yet.

lines.zh: 我把影子藏进浪里。
lines.en: I hide my shadow inside the swell.

lines.zh: 稳住，等我靠近。
lines.en: Hold steady and let me close the gap.

lines.zh: 它在动，我跟着动。
lines.en: It moves, so I move with it.

lines.zh: 我的帆现在不反光。
lines.en: My sail does not catch the light now.

lines.zh: 绕到它背后，别急。
lines.en: Swing behind it, but do not rush.

lines.zh: 水浅了，我减速。
lines.en: The water is shallowing, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 就快够着了，你抓紧。
lines.en: Almost within reach, so hold on tight.

lines.zh: 我把帆收窄，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I trim the sail narrow and ease across.

lines.zh: 水流变急，我先横一横壳。
lines.en: The current quickens, so I turn broadside first.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边走，不惊动水面。
lines.en: I hug the shore to keep the water calm.

lines.zh: 再往前就是浅滩，我停住。
lines.en: The shallows start ahead, so I stop.

lines.zh: 我用壳沿撞过去，木头都响。
lines.en: I ram with my shell rim and even the wood rings.

lines.zh: 船头压下去，撞它个正着。
lines.en: I drop my bow and hit it square on.

lines.zh: 我的螺旋壳比看上去硬。
lines.en: My spiral shell is harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得水花四溅。
lines.en: That hit throws spray in every direction.

lines.zh: 它撞我，我加倍撞回去。
lines.en: It hits me, so I hit back twice as hard.

lines.zh: 帆杆扫过去，像一根棍。
lines.en: The boom sweeps across like a club.

lines.zh: 别站船头，我要顶了。
lines.en: Do not stand on the bow; I am about to ram.

lines.zh: 推进器全开，直接碾过去。
lines.en: Thrusters wide open, I drive straight over it.

lines.zh: 我的壳一沉，压住它。
lines.en: My shell drops and pins it down.

lines.zh: 木头裂了，可我还在撞。
lines.en: The wood splits, but I keep ramming.

lines.zh: 撞完我自己也转了三圈。
lines.en: After the hit I spin three full circles myself.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的帆，我甩开。
lines.en: It grabs my sail and I shake it off.

lines.zh: 甲板上的东西都撞飞了。
lines.en: Everything on deck goes flying on impact.

lines.zh: 我撞不痛，可它痛。
lines.en: I feel no pain from ramming, but it does.

lines.zh: 我用船尾扫过去，木头发闷。
lines.en: I swing my stern across; the wood thuds dully.

lines.zh: 推进器一顶，我撞进它侧身。
lines.en: The thruster shoves me into its flank.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一落地，我就浮起来。
lines.en: The spawn egg lands and I rise to the surface.

lines.zh: 我本来不该自然出现，是被放的。
lines.en: I should not occur naturally; I was placed here.

lines.zh: 壳先浮上来，帆后展开。
lines.en: The shell surfaces first, then the sail unfurls.

lines.zh: 谁把我从蛋里叫出来的。
lines.en: Who called me out of that egg?

lines.zh: 水托住我，我一时间睁不开眼。
lines.en: Water holds me up and I cannot quite open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我一出现就带着空货舱。
lines.en: I arrive with an empty cargo hold.

lines.zh: 这地方的水温我喜欢。
lines.en: I like the temperature of the water here.

lines.zh: 没人骑我，我就顺流漂。
lines.en: With no rider, I drift with the current.

lines.zh: 刚从蛋里出来，壳还湿。
lines.en: Fresh from the egg, my shell is still wet.

lines.zh: 我落水的声音很闷。
lines.en: The sound of me hitting the water is muffled.

lines.zh: 帆自己就张开了。
lines.en: The sail opens all by itself.

lines.zh: 我被放在这里，就漂在这里。
lines.en: I was placed here, so here I drift.

lines.zh: 第一波浪推我转了个向。
lines.en: The first wave turns me in a new direction.

lines.zh: 你放的蛋，你得负责开我。
lines.en: You placed the egg, so you must steer me.

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳里被放到水面上。
lines.en: I am set down on the water from the egg.

lines.zh: 壳先落水，帆还卷着没收。
lines.en: The shell lands first, sail still furled.

lines.zh: 这湾水够深，我就泊在这儿。
lines.en: This bay is deep enough, so I moor here.

lines.zh: 有人把我摆正，我才浮稳。
lines.en: Someone sets me straight, then I float steady.

lines.zh: 我落下来时溅了一身水。
lines.en: I splash myself all over coming down.

lines.zh: 蛋一裂，我就带着空舱漂。
lines.en: The egg cracks and I drift off with empty holds.

lines.zh: 燃料着了，我整壳都在烧。
lines.en: The fuel caught and my whole shell is burning.

lines.zh: 我从浪上摔下去，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall off the swell and land shell first.

lines.zh: 我沉下去了，水正往壳里灌。
lines.en: I am sinking and water pours into my shell.

lines.zh: 这一炸把我帆都掀飞了。
lines.en: That blast tore my sail clean off.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的壳上，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my shell and will not pull out.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的帆自己转了。
lines.en: That force turns my sail by itself.

lines.zh: 炉子空了，我一点力气也没有。
lines.en: The furnace is empty and I have no strength left.

lines.zh: 雷劈中帆杆，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the mast and my whole frame tingles.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界，壳在往下坠。
lines.en: I have fallen out of the world and my shell keeps dropping.
